definitions.explanation: the involuntary grinding or clenching of teeth, often during sleep

examples.japanese: {睡眠中|すいみんちゅう}に{歯|は}ぎしりをする。
examples.english: I grind my teeth in my sleep.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}ぎしりのせいで{歯|は}がすり{減|へ}った。
examples.english: My teeth wore down because of grinding.

examples.japanese: マウスピースで{歯|は}ぎしりを{防|ふせ}ぐ。
examples.english: I use a mouthguard to prevent teeth grinding.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}けて{歯|は}ぎしりする{思|おも}いだ。
examples.english: Losing was frustrating enough to make me gnash my teeth.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{悔|くや}しくて{歯|は}ぎしりした。
examples.english: He was so frustrated he gnashed his teeth.

examples.japanese: チャンスを{逃|のが}して{歯|は}ぎしりするほど{悔|くや}しい。
examples.english: Missing the chance was frustrating enough to make me want to gnash my teeth.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{歯|は}ぎしり (bruxism) often occurs during sleep and can cause:
- {歯|は}のすり{減|へ}り - tooth wear
- {顎|あご}の{痛|いた}み - jaw pain
- {頭痛|ずつう} - headaches

FIGURATIVE USE:
The figurative meaning expresses intense frustration, regret, or vexation - the feeling of wanting to gnash one's teeth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯|は}ぎしりをする - to grind one's teeth
- {歯|は}ぎしりする{思|おも}い - frustrating feeling
- {悔|くや}しくて{歯|は}ぎしりする - to gnash teeth in frustration

TREATMENT:
- マウスピース / ナイトガード - mouthguard/night guard

RELATED:
- {歯|は}を{食|く}いしばる - to clench one's teeth
- {悔|くや}しい - frustrating, vexing
